final: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL AND link_to_member <> '' GROUP BY link_to_member), t AS (SELECT link_to_member, s, s * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(s) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.s) AS total_amount, AVG(t.share) AS avg_share_kept, AVG(t.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM t, a WHERE t.share > a.avg_share
